articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin sinks below $83,000 as Iran talks stall and oil climbs
articles.snippet: ZEC led losses among major tokens as Brent pushed toward $108 and traders added to bets on another Fed rate increase ahead of this week's inflation and jobs data.

articles.title: California's Newsom signs memecoin ban and calls it 'The Opposite of Trump'
articles.snippet: The California Governor signed AB 2409 as part of an anti-corruption package, framing it as a response to President Trump's $TRUMP fiasco.

articles.title: Bitcoin could soon get Zcash-style 'shielded' privacy without changing its rules
articles.snippet: Researchers have mapped out private bitcoin-denominated transfers that run alongside Bitcoin, but the system still lacks a finished way to lock up real BTC and release it again.

articles.title: Solana’s 150-millisecond settlement upgrade reaches second public test network
articles.snippet: Alpenglow is running on both public test networks, giving application teams a place to check their software before the live blockchain switches.

articles.title: XRP Ledger’s Batch upgrade slips to Oct. 9 after validator support resets
articles.snippet: The feature would let users bundle up to eight transactions, including asset-and-payment transfers, but a brief drop below the network’s 80% support threshold restarted its two-week activation clock.
